`class MaskNodeEffect`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeEffect<Node>`](/reference/effects/nodeeffect/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.effect.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [MaskNodeEffect.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/effect/impl/MaskNodeEffect.java)

Hides every pixel of a node and its children outside a rectangle, or outside the opaque part of an image.

![A gradient window inside a white rectangle with a grey outline: the white part is the rest of the node, which the mask hides](/captures/catalog-effects-masknodeeffect.webp)

## Description

The rectangle starts at the top-left corner of the node and, without a size, covers the bounds of the node: `MaskNodeEffect.create()` alone hides what the children draw outside the node.
Masks nest: a masked node inside another mask shows only what both keep.
Its priority is `0` ([Control the order of effects](/use/learn/style-and-motion/effects/#control-the-order-of-effects)).
The mask clips the drawing only: the hidden part of the node still receives the mouse.

<a id="MaskNodeEffect-property-resource"></a>

### resource

- `this resource(Resource resource)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this resource(Supplier<Resource> resourceSupplier)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `Resource getResource()` 

**Default:** `null`

[`Resource`](/reference/resources/resource/) stretched over the visible rectangle, whose opaque part forms the mask: it keeps the pixels where the image has an alpha above `0.5F`, so the edges are hard.
`null` masks with the plain rectangle.
